# QuintaDB

QuintaDB is a no-code online database and application builder for managing databases, forms, fields, records, reports, and files.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/quintadb/.

## Actions

- **Create Record**: Create one record in a QuintaDB form using values keyed by field ID.
- **Create Records**: Create 2-100 QuintaDB records using sequential individual API calls in input order.
- **Delete Records By ID**: Permanently delete only the explicitly supplied QuintaDB record IDs from one form.
- **Get Database** (read-only): Get metadata and resource counts for one allowed QuintaDB database by app ID.
- **Get Record** (read-only): Get one record by exact ID from an allowed QuintaDB database.
- **List Fields** (read-only): List the fields in a QuintaDB form, including field IDs and types.
- **List Forms** (read-only): List forms/tables in an allowed QuintaDB database, including IDs and record counts needed for field and record operations.
- **List Records** (read-only): Return one page of records from a QuintaDB form, optionally constrained to a report.
- **List Reports** (read-only): List QuintaDB reports/views for a form.
- **Search Records** (read-only): Search records in one QuintaDB form using explicit field or system-column predicates.
- **Update Record**: Update selected fields on one QuintaDB record using a field-ID keyed values object.
- **Update Records By ID**: Update 2-100 exact QuintaDB record IDs using sequential individual API calls in input order.
